# Luanette

> A Lua game console for ESP32-S3 boards, and a browser playground running the same engine. A game (a cart) is one Lua 5.4 file: a 128x128 picture in 16 colors, 8x8 sprites, tile maps, its own sounds and music, a full-color layer and a lit 3D scene. Make carts with `npx luanette` (check, run with input and screenshots, sounds, share links) or its MCP server (`npx luanette mcp`).

Start with AGENTS.md: it has the cart format, the check-run-look-fix loop, the limits and the pitfalls (it isn't PICO-8: no `+=`, no `all()`, `log()` instead of `printh`).

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Geofresh/luanette/blob/main/AGENTS.md): making a cart, for agents
- [docs/api.md](https://github.com/Geofresh/luanette/blob/main/docs/api.md): the whole API
- [docs/cli.md](https://github.com/Geofresh/luanette/blob/main/docs/cli.md): the command-line tool, the input script and the MCP tools
- [docs/DESIGN.md](https://github.com/Geofresh/luanette/blob/main/docs/DESIGN.md): making a cart run well and use the whole screen
- [docs/tutorial.md](https://github.com/Geofresh/luanette/blob/main/docs/tutorial.md): a first game, step by step

## Carts to read

- [templates/](https://github.com/Geofresh/luanette/tree/main/templates): blank, platformer, shooter, puzzle
- [examples/](https://github.com/Geofresh/luanette/tree/main/examples): seven complete carts; overworld.lua is a giant map built from blocks
- [gallery/](https://github.com/Geofresh/luanette/tree/main/gallery): carts people made

## Optional

- [The playground](https://geofresh.github.io/luanette/): edit, run, draw sprites and maps, make sounds and music, send to a board
- [README.md](https://github.com/Geofresh/luanette/blob/main/README.md)
